name: POLS 3675
title: Practicum in Campaigns and Elections in the United States
description: Study of and skill-development to effectively participate in U.S. political campaigns and elections.
requirement_description: POLS 1602/W (or with instructor consent, an equivalent introductory American government course at a different institution or Advanced Placement), and one of POLS 2607, 2622, 3603WQ, 3604, 3606, 3608, 3612, 3613, or 3625/PP 3030/W.
